bullets.text: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor progress for commuter safety.
Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran is among four police officers transferred by the home secretary, and the office should note the leadership change.
Poonamallee Mount Road faced severe Diwali traffic congestion, and the office should coordinate with local traffic police to ease movement.
Avadi railway passengers flagged delays in sanctioned platform reconstruction work, and the office should follow up with railway authorities.
Avadi and Tambaram police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized narcotics and contraband, and the office should acknowledge their anti drug efforts.
Vultr launched a 20 megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by AMD GPUs, and the office should welcome this digital infrastructure growth.
University of Madras approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab, and the office should support academic tech partnerships.
